json.name: exposure_metrics
json.description: Market exposure by counterparty, instrument and book. Synthetic demo data.
json.nativeDefinition:
version: 1.1

source: main.obda_metric_test.pos_eod

joins:
  - name: cpty
    source: main.obda_metric_test.cpty_mstr
    "on": source.cpty_id = cpty.cpty_id
  - name: instr
    source: main.obda_metric_test.instr_ref
    "on": source.instr_id = instr.instr_id
    joins:
      - name: issuer
        source: main.obda_metric_test.cpty_mstr
        "on": instr.issuer_cpty_id = issuer.cpty_id

filter: mv_usd IS NOT NULL

dimensions:
  - name: jurisdiction
    expr: cpty.ctry_cd

  - name: counterparty
    expr: cpty.legal_nm

  - name: asset_class
    expr: instr.asset_cls_cd

  - name: issuer_jurisdiction
    expr: instr.issuer.ctry_cd

  - name: book
    expr: source.book_cd

  - name: cob_date
    expr: source.cob_dt

measures:
  - name: market_value
    expr: SUM(source.mv_usd)

  - name: notional
    expr: SUM(source.ntnl_amt)

  - name: position_count
    expr: COUNT(1)

  - name: avg_market_value
    expr: MEASURE(market_value) / MEASURE(position_count)

  - name: market_value_trailing_5d
    expr: SUM(source.mv_usd)
    window:
      - order: cob_date
        semiadditive: last
        range: trailing 5 day

materialization:
  schedule: EVERY 6 HOURS
  mode: relaxed
  materialized_views:
    - name: by_jurisdiction
      type: aggregated
      dimensions:
        - jurisdiction
        - cob_date
      measures:
        - market_value
        - position_count
